scope: 4D, known uniform physical density, externally known proper diamond duration T=1, apex BD curvature R=-2 B(1), restricted de Sitter C2 inversion; no general proper-time inference
selection: Per density, minimize raw BD mean-square error of four development-flat group means; first candidate wins ties. No bias subtraction, curved tuning or test reselection.
intervals: Nominal 95% Student intervals across independent clouds within each group; C2 interval transforms probability limits. Coverage is empirical, not a finite-sample theorem. Supplementary conditional-N Hoeffding C2 interval is separately reported; old fixed-N Bennett bound is not reused.
failure_policy: No added samples, post-test tuning or dropping failed groups. Empty C2 intervals and boundary clipping remain visible. Any N<2 makes the comparison incomplete. Hard budget failure retains completed cells.
